title: magere-brug Recipe
description: Recipe schema for referencing source manifests and GOZ1 packs, and for driving the pack runner (`magere pack-goz1` on goz1_pack/ternary_pack recipes carrying a `pack` block) and the SAAQ runner (`magere run-saaq` on saaq recipes carrying a `saaq` block).

type.description: Recipe kind. goz1_pack/ternary_pack drive packing; saaq runs SAAQ validation.

source_manifest.description: Path or registry id of the source model manifest

goz1_ref.description: Path or registry id of a registered GOZ1 pack (for post-pack steps such as SAAQ)

generated_format.description: Format of the primary generated artifact; prefer goz1

manifest_id.description: Manifest id to write or update after the recipe

output_dir.description: Directory for pack or SAAQ run outputs

pack.description: Pack runner configuration for goz1_pack/ternary_pack recipes, consumed by `magere pack-goz1` and mapped onto magere-grok-process QuantizeConfig. Omit for reference-only recipes that merely point at an existing pack. NOTE: while the packer is a skeleton, `dissect_manifest` is the only field that affects the emitted pack; the rest are validated and recorded but inert -- run_quantize discards the QuantizeConfig entirely.

dissect_manifest.description: Path to the xai-dissect DissectManifest JSON (schema_version 1, name_convention xai-dissect-v1) that lists preserve/fp16/ternary_candidates tiers. This is the only pack field that currently affects the emitted bytes: the tensor names and tiers here become the pack's tensor table.

input_dir.description: INERT while the packer is a skeleton: magere-grok-process::stream::run_quantize takes its QuantizeConfig as `_config` and discards it, so this field is validated and recorded but does not affect the emitted bytes. Only `dissect_manifest` does. Becomes live when real tensor loading lands. Directory holding the packable source weights (safetensors shards or a directory of .npy files). Its existence is reported as a note, not required, because the skeleton packer never reads it.

input_format.description: INERT while the packer is a skeleton: magere-grok-process::stream::run_quantize takes its QuantizeConfig as `_config` and discards it, so this field is validated and recorded but does not affect the emitted bytes. Only `dissect_manifest` does. Becomes live when real tensor loading lands. Weight container layout of input_dir; maps to magere-grok-process InputFormat.

gif_threshold.description: INERT while the packer is a skeleton: magere-grok-process::stream::run_quantize takes its QuantizeConfig as `_config` and discards it, so this field is validated and recorded but does not affect the emitted bytes. Only `dissect_manifest` does. Becomes live when real tensor loading lands. GIF saliency threshold ratio used when ternarizing.

use_embedded_baseline.description: INERT while the packer is a skeleton: magere-grok-process::stream::run_quantize takes its QuantizeConfig as `_config` and discards it, so this field is validated and recorded but does not affect the emitted bytes. Only `dissect_manifest` does. Becomes live when real tensor loading lands. Use the packer's embedded baseline statistics instead of deriving them from input_dir.

allow_model_mismatch.description: When true, skip the check that the source manifest and dissect manifest name the same model family. Default is to refuse a pack whose tensor table comes from a different family than the recorded model identity.

saaq.description: SAAQ runner configuration, consumed by `magere run-saaq` for recipes of type "saaq". Drives the CPU-only validation pipeline in magere-corinth-core (TelemetrySnapshot -> TelemetryFunnel -> Projector -> SnnLatentCalibrator). Every field has a documented default, so a thin saaq stub still runs.

projection_mode.description: Projector strategy used to turn hidden spike activity into the dense embedding (magere-corinth-core ProjectionMode).

snn_steps.description: SNN time-steps expanded per telemetry snapshot by the telemetry funnel.

thresholds.description: Per-channel TelemetryEncoder thresholds, in channel order: gpu_temp_c, gpu_power_w, cpu_tctl_c, cpu_package_power_w.

update_rule.description: SAAQ delta-Q update rule (magere-corinth-core SaaqUpdateRule). Under dual_rule it selects which rule fills the legacy saaq_delta_q_{prev,target} columns.

dual_rule.description: Observe both SAAQ rules through SnnDualLatentCalibrator so each CSV row carries the legacy and v1.5 trajectories side by side.

num_experts.description: PLACEHOLDER SURROGATE - not the model's real MoE router. Number of contiguous proportional projector-embedding slices whose per-slice means are softmaxed to derive the routing distribution behind the routing_entropy column. The proportional boundaries partition every embedding position and slice widths differ by at most one. Derived only from telemetry-driven SNN activity; no model weights are read. Capped at the projector embedding dim (2048) so every expert owns at least one position. Note routing_entropy stays within ~1% of its uniform maximum over a typical run, so treat it as a recorded diagnostic rather than a live routing signal.

top_k.description: Recorded-only provenance: experts listed in selected_experts each tick; must not exceed num_experts. The calibrator reads only expert_weights, so top_k cannot change latent_telemetry.csv - runs differing only in top_k are byte-identical. It documents the intended routing fan-out for the downstream handoff.

telemetry.description: Source of the TelemetrySnapshot stream. Defaults to a synthetic ramp so a checked-in recipe runs with no external data.

source.description: synthetic: each snapshot is a pure function of the tick index (no RNG, no wall clock, byte-reproducible CSV). csv: snapshots are replayed from the file at `path`.

ticks.description: synthetic only - number of telemetry ticks to replay; equals the emitted CSV row count.

tick_interval_ms.description: synthetic only - milliseconds between ticks; also fixes the emitted timestamp_ms column.

start_timestamp_ms.description: synthetic only - timestamp_ms of tick 0. Recipe-derived, never read from the system clock.

start.description: synthetic only - channel values at tick 0.

delta.description: synthetic only - per-tick channel increment; channel c at tick i is start.c + delta.c * i.

path.description: csv only - telemetry CSV carrying the columns timestamp_ms, gpu_temp_c, gpu_power_w, cpu_tctl_c and cpu_package_power_w in any order.

allOf.$comment: A pack block only makes sense on packing recipes. It stays optional so reference-only goz1_pack/ternary_pack stubs remain valid; `magere pack-goz1` requires it at run time.
